meta.name: send
meta.description: The rules of the send capability (jav/app/sending.py). The real send through Outlook reaches only the recipients listed here: an address, or '@domain' for a whole domain. Empty: nothing goes out by the real send; the output folder and the Outlook draft are not limited by it. Only an owner's decision adds a recipient.

changelog.note: The first version; the real send's allowlist is empty.
The notes and the description without the development process's references; no value changes.
